summary: Iteration 3 tested (a) backend domain normalize on save + host resolve variants and (b) show_header/show_footer toggle propagation. Added 2 new pytest tests to /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -> all 17 tests pass in ~9s. Playwright: logged in as admin, opened a site editor, on Görünüm tab toggled set-show-header -> [data-testid=public-title] inside data-testid=live-preview disappeared; toggled set-show-footer -> <footer> inside live-preview disappeared. Restored both switches to leave demo state clean.
critical_code_review_comments: normalize_domain covers protocol/www/port/trailing slash/dot/casing; no punycode/IDN handling but out-of-scope.
resolve_site does not require published=True check by domain? It does: 'not site.get("published")' returns 404 — verified. Good.
SiteSettings.show_header/show_footer default True; PublicSiteRenderer treats missing as true — backward compatible with pre-existing sites (verified via demo).
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates+deletes TEST_ prefixed sites within a single test; no persistent data left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Domain normalize + show_header/show_footer verified end-to-end. Selectors: set-show-header, set-show-footer, live-preview, public-title. Backend endpoint /api/public/resolve accepts either slug or host; host is normalized identically to save.
